<!-- WARNING: knitr RUNS chunks and inline code even inside an HTML comment
     like this one. Use #| eval: false to disable one. -->
<!-- This file carries the supplementary FIGURES AND TABLES. For
     supplementary TEXT (an extended Methods, say) that needs its own
     reference list, add a second file with no sfig/stbl div in it,
     12.2_suppl_methods.qmd, and include it in manuscript.qmd below this
     one: nothing else needs touching. Where the figures end up -- their own
     document or the end of the main text -- is
     make_submission(suppl_figures = ). See the README. -->
<!-- Supplementary material is numbered independently with an S prefix. The
     sfig and stbl types are defined under crossref: custom: in _quarto.yml.
     Cite them from ANYWHERE in the manuscript with @sfig-map / @stbl-raw.
     Syntax: a div carrying the id, the content inside, and the legend as the
     last paragraph of the div. -->
<!-- The supplement is also rendered as a document of its own, by
     render_docx(), render_pdf() and make_submission(). That document runs
     R/setup.R and this file only, not the chunks of the other sections: what
     a supplementary figure or table needs -- the data, a model -- is read or
     computed here, in a chunk at the top. -->

::: {#sfig-map}

```{r}
#| label: suppl-map
#| include: true
#| fig-width: 7.09
#| fig-height: 6.30
plot.new(); box(col = "grey80")
text(0.5, 0.5, "figure S1", cex = 2, col = "grey60")
```

```{r}
#| label: suppl-raw
#| include: true
flextable(head(iris, 3)) |>
  align(part = "all", align = "left") |>
  hline_top(border = fp_border_default(width = 0), part = "all") |>
  hline_bottom(border = fp_border_default(style = "solid", color = "black",
                                          width = 1), part = "all") |>
  fit_flextable_to_page()
```
